items.title: Are Latent Reasoning Models Easily Interpretable?
items.author: arxiv.org via Yogthos
items.summary_raw:
Models normally do all their reasoning in a continuous hidden state instead of spitting out readable text which makes them hard to monitor. The authors tested the Coconut and CODI models and it turns out these models barely even use their hidden reasoning steps for logical tasks like PrOntoQA and ProsQA. You can force the models to stop thinking early and they almost always spit out the same response anyway. It turns out that their high performance on logical tasks actually comes from their specific training data rather than the extra thinking during inference.

Things get even more interesting when the models actually need those reasoning tokens for math problems. The researchers wanted to know if standard step-by-step math solutions were hidden inside the latent space, and projected the hidden states back into regular vocabulary words to check. And sure enough when the models got the math problem right the researchers found the correct intermediate math steps in their hidden states up to 93% of the time. The finding strongly suggests that the models are basically doing standard math steps in the background.

They confirmed the exact math operations taking place by tweaking numbers in the prompt and seeing how the hidden states reacted which allowed decoding a verified reasoning path for a large majority of correct predictions. But they could rarely do this for incorrect predictions proving that models are actually way more interpretable than the AI community assumed. And you can even use that interpretability as a signal to guess if the model is about to give a right or wrong answer.

Comments
items.summary: 这篇论文探讨了潜在推理模型（如 Coconut 和 CODI）的可解释性问题。研究发现，这些模型在逻辑任务（如 PrOntoQA 和 ProsQA）中几乎不使用隐藏推理步骤，其高性能主要来自训练数据而非推理过程；但在数学问题中，模型确实在隐藏状态中执行标准的分步计算，且正确预测时中间步骤可被解码还原的比例高达 93%。该研究挑战了'潜在推理模型不可解释'的普遍假设，并提出可将可解释性作为预测模型输出正确性的信号。

items.summary: OpenAI 宣布将 ChatGPT for Teachers 扩展到美国 55 个学区，覆盖超过 10 万名教育工作者，提供安全 AI 工具、培训和支持。该举措旨在帮助教师减轻行政负担、提升教学效率，并推动 AI 在教育领域的规范化应用。值得关注的是，它展示了 AI 在垂直行业落地的最新进展，以及 OpenAI 对教育市场的战略布局。

items.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
items.summary_raw: OpenAI shares findings from the Hugging Face security incident and the steps we’re taking to strengthen AI model security, monitoring, and alignment.
items.summary: OpenAI 针对其 Hugging Face 账户遭遇的安全事件发布了详细调查结果，揭示了攻击者通过泄露的访问令牌获取模型权重等敏感信息的过程。文章不仅复盘了事件本身，还提出了加强 AI 模型安全、监控和一致性对齐的具体措施，包括改进密钥管理、引入更严格的访问控制以及增强模型行为监控。该文对于理解 AI 供应链安全、模型权重保护以及企业级安全响应具有重要参考价值，值得安全工程师和 AI 平台开发者关注。

items.title: How loveholidays is making everyone a builder with Codex
items.summary_raw: Discover how loveholidays uses OpenAI Codex to make software development accessible across the business, helping teams turn ideas into products faster.
items.summary: 本文介绍了在线旅游公司 loveholidays 如何利用 OpenAI 的 Codex 工具，让非技术员工也能参与软件开发，从而加速从创意到产品的转化。文章展示了 Codex 在降低编程门槛、赋能业务团队方面的实际应用，并强调了 AI 辅助开发在企业中的潜力。对于关注 AI 在软件开发中落地实践的人士，本文提供了有价值的案例参考。

items.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
items.summary_raw: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.
items.summary: OpenAI 首席财务官 Sarah Friar 撰文阐述其“富足智能”愿景，指出芯片、算力、模型和产品四个层面的进步相互叠加，共同推动智能的规模化应用与成本下降。文章从商业和战略角度解释了 OpenAI 如何通过全栈优化实现更高效、更普及的 AI 服务，并强调了持续投资基础设施的重要性。对于关注 AI 产业发展趋势和商业化路径的读者，本文提供了来自核心决策者的第一手视角，值得一读。

items.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
items.summary_raw: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.
items.summary: OpenAI 发布了其自研推理芯片 Jalapeño 的首批测试结果，宣称在 AI 推理速度和能效上达到行业领先水平。该芯片针对现代大模型优化，提供更高吞吐量和更低延迟，同时显著降低功耗。这一进展对 AI 基础设施的性价比和可持续性有重要影响，值得关注其后续量产和实际部署表现。

items.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
items.summary_raw: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.
items.summary: OpenAI 披露其安全团队发现并封禁了一批源自俄罗斯的账户，这些账户利用 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT）生成内容，伪装成以色列智库，推广一个所谓的“主权”指数，该指数旨在赞扬俄罗斯并批评西方。此次行动是 OpenAI 持续打击 AI 滥用、防范隐蔽影响力行动的一部分。该事件值得关注，因为它展示了 AI 在信息战中的潜在滥用风险，以及平台方如何通过技术手段进行检测和干预，对于理解 AI 安全治理和地缘政治背景下的内容操纵具有参考价值。

items.title: Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
items.summary_raw: Use the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests.
items.summary: OpenAI 发布了面向 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 的 Admin 插件，旨在帮助企业管理员高效管理工作区。该插件支持分析工作区使用情况、管理成员和权限、调整限制以及处理管理员请求，解决了企业在部署 AI 工具时面临的治理和运维难题。值得关注的是，它标志着 OpenAI 从面向个人开发者转向企业级管理生态，对采用 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的企业具有直接的操作指导意义。

items.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
items.summary_raw: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.
items.summary: Stampli 是一家财务软件公司，在面临固定截止日期且设计资源被占用的困境下，利用 OpenAI 的 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 将原本需要数周的发布准备工作压缩至数天完成，实现了启动时间缩短 68% 的显著效果。该案例展示了企业如何将 LLM 工具深度嵌入实际工作流，不仅用于代码生成，还用于跨团队协作和任务自动化，是 AI 提升企业运营效率的典型实践。值得关注的是，它提供了具体的量化收益和真实业务场景，对评估 LLM 在企业级应用中的投资回报率具有参考价值。

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.summary_raw: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布启动一项新计划，旨在加强人工智能在国家安全领域的民主监督。该计划将为政府机构提供工具、培训和专业知识，帮助其更好地理解和监管AI在国家安全中的应用。此举反映了AI技术日益融入国家安全事务后，对透明度和问责制的迫切需求。值得关注的是，它展示了领先AI公司如何主动与公共部门合作，以平衡技术创新与民主价值观，对政策制定者和技术从业者均有参考意义。
